AN ACT MODERNIZING THE BUREAU OF IMMIGRATION BY DEFINING ITS POWERS AND
FUNCTIONS, FURTHER PROFESSIONALIZING ITS ORGANIZATION, UPGRADING
THE COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS OF ITS OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES, AND
APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Bureau Of Immigration Modernization Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to comply with the obligations and standards set by the international law in the admission or exclusion of foreign nationals.
Promotes international order and justice by denying the use of Philippine territory to persons who are engaged or likely to engage in terrorism, human smuggling and trafficking, criminal and other nefarious activities.
Harmonizes existing immigration rules and regulations pertaining to issuance of visas to foreign nationals.
Seeks to upgrade the qualifications and raises salaries of immigration service officers and personnel to be at least at par with other government agencies under the Department of Justice.
Creates an Immigration Trust Fund (ITF) which shall be sourced from thirty percent (30%) of the immigration fees, fines and penalties, and other income that may be collected by the Bureau for the effective implementation of this Act, provided it does not exceed One billion two hundred million pesos (P1,200,000,000.00) every year.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ACADEMIC RECOVERY AND ACCESSIBLE LEARNING
PROGRAM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Academic Recovery And Accessible Learning ( A R A L ) Program Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to ensure that all learners who are struggling in their lessons shall attain the most essential learning competencies especially in reading, mathematics, and science.
Covers the Most Essential Learning Competencies (MELCs) under the K to 12 Basic Education Curriculum covering the subjects of Language and Mathematics for Grades 1 to 10, and Science for Grades 3 to 10.
Mandates tutors under the ARAL program to be responsible for conducting the lessons to ensure the learners´ attainment of the MELCs of the respective subjects.
Prescribes that tutorial sessions shall be conducted  under the following delivery modes: a. face-to-face tutorials; b.) online tutorials; and c.) blended learning, where a specified number of tutorial sessions include online and face-to face tutorials.
Exempts grants, bequests, endowments, donations and contributions to the ARAL Program of the DepEd from the payment of the donor´s tax and the cost of which shall be considered as an allowable deduction from computation of the income tax of the donor in accordance with the provisions of the National Internal Revenue Code of 1997, as amended.

Establishes the Philippine Atomic Energy Regulatory Authority otherwise known as the Phil ATOM and provide for a comprehensive technical and legal safety framework for the utilization and application of Nuclear Energy in the Philippines.

AN ACT REVITALIZING THE SALT INDUSTRY, CREATING A COMPREHENSIVE PLAN
FOR ITS DEVELOPMENT, PROVIDING INCENTIVES TO SALT FARMERS,
PRODUCERS AND EXPORTERS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Philippine Salt Industry Development Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to revitalize the salt industry through appropriate technology and research, and adequate financial, production, marketing, and other support services , attain increased income for salt farmers and salt producers and achieve salt self-sufficiency.
Establishes the Philippine Salt Industry Development Roadmap (“Roadmap”) which shall include programs, projects, interventions and incentives for the development and management, research, processing, utilization, modernization business development, and commercialization of Philippine salt.
Mandates the Department of Agriculture to ensure that salt is a priority commodity to be produced locally in areas or regions identified in this Act, as well as in the development plan for the salt industry.
Provides incentives to investors in salt farm development and salt processing facilities.
Requires all salt produced or manufactured in the Philippines shall be labeled as “Made in the Philippines” in a prominent and conspicuous manner on the product, its packaging, and accompanying documentation, and shall comply with the requirements of RA 7394, otherwise known as the “Consumer Act of the Philippines.”

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS FROM INTERVENING IN THE IMPLEMENTATION OF NATIONAL GOVERNMENT PROJECTS
rows.abstract:
States that “No local government unit shall intervene, obstruct, delay, or otherwise impede the implementation of any national government project, including but not limited to infrastructure projects, health programs, and education programs.”
Provides that the prohibition shall not apply in cases where the assistance of the LGU is specifically requested by the NGA or office in charge of the project . . .
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2023-05-24
